title: Bi-nationally Supervised Doctoral Degrees / Cotutelle
summary: This DAAD programme funds doctoral candidates for bi-nationally supervised research stays in Germany via a sandwich model or Cotutelle procedure.

degree_levels.notes: Applicants must have earned a Master's degree or Diplom (or exceptional Bachelor's) for the sandwich model, or be admitted to a doctoral programme for the Cotutelle model.

subject_areas.notes: No subject restrictions mentioned in general overview, though human medicine, veterinary medicine, and dentistry have separate regulations.

institutions.notes: Research stays at a state or state-recognised institution of higher education or a non-university research institute in Germany.

nationality.notes: Country eligibility depends on the specific list in the application portal; origin-unspecified DAAD page details apply.

residence.notes: Application cannot be considered if resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

mandatory.text: Most recent university degree should have been obtained no more than six years ago before the application deadline.
Start of the doctorate should not be longer than 3 years ago at the time of application.
Cannot have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

funding.description: Monthly payments of 1,400 euros during the stay in Germany. Payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover. Research allowance of 460 euros. Additional benefits for uninterrupted stays over 6 months may apply on application.
funding.duration: Between 7 and a maximum of 24 months

application_rounds.notes: Applications are possible between 1 June and the stated application deadline, updated annually.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications possible between 1 June and the application deadline each year.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
List of published publications (max. 10 pages), if applicable
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects
Proof of admission to/enrolment for doctoral studies at the home university, including start date
All university degree certificates already obtained
Option a: Written confirmation, agreed and signed by both academic advisers / Option b: Cotutelle contract or confirmation from academic adviser in Germany
One recent, supporting letter of recommendation from a university teacher

steps.text: Request recommendation form in the portal and have it completed
Fill out online application form and upload all required documents in PDF format

sources.title: Bi-nationally Supervised Doctoral Degrees / Cotutelle - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme funds international doctoral students for research stays and doctoral degrees carried out physically in Germany.
